opportunities.name: Subjugate AP domain
opportunities.objective: Test AP-scaled percent-health R while using W to support recovery.
opportunities.mechanic: R drains max-health magic damage with an AP term and steals 40% defenses over five seconds. W increases healing by 25%; Visage tests its combination with actual R recovery, and Riftmaker/AP investments support the drain while Cosmic helps keep contact. Q remains primarily an AD attack tool.
opportunities.requiredState: High-health enemy, R available and Trundle remains within W during measured recovery.
opportunities.failure: R cooldown or a low-health target makes the AP budget much less useful than attack items.
opportunities.test: Measure R damage/heal each second inside versus outside W, with Visage separately enabled.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Defense theft happens over time rather than granting the full amount at cast.

opportunities.name: Pillar Chomp fifth hit
opportunities.objective: Use temporary terrain and AD theft to secure a five-attack structure or duel cycle.
opportunities.mechanic: E creates a six-second slow obstacle and W supplies substantial attack speed; Q steals AD for five seconds. Hullbreaker pays after fifth real attacks, Trinity rewards Q's spell-followed attack and Titanic tests attack splash. The opponent's temporary AD loss can matter during the duel.
opportunities.requiredState: Pillar blocks the intended escape path and Q theft remains active during attacks.
opportunities.failure: Target escapes around the pillar or five-hit cadence is interrupted by peel.
opportunities.test: Record Q AD theft, five-attack timing and Hullbreaker damage against champion and turret separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Pillar displacement is not a listed damage spell and does not itself deliver attack items.

ruledOut.reason: E lists terrain, displacement and a slow without an AP damage expression.

unknowns: R primary summary says four-second delayed theft while detailed tooltip says five seconds; measure actual theft/heal timing. W/Visage combination and Q item delivery must be observed.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: R cooldown or a low-health target makes the AP budget much less useful than attack items.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Defense theft happens over time rather than granting the full amount at cast.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Riftmaker, Rabadon's Deathcap, Cosmic Drive, Spirit Visage, Abyssal Mask, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
